package.name: drishti_sim_isaac
package.description: NVIDIA Isaac Sim backend. Builds the robot and the Easy/Medium/Hard worlds in USD from the same URDF and SDF files the Gazebo backend uses, and publishes the SPEC.md section 4.1 topic contract through Isaac Sim's own ROS 2 bridge. Isaac Sim itself is an external dependency (ISAAC_SIM_PATH); it is not a ROS package and is not declared here.
